prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, mid 30s goddess, hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size; below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds; enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long straight balayage hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of four stacked horizontal electric-blue neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, joined by one short vertical tube between them, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of violet neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: standing front-facing with her weight on one leg, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass SSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy cobalt blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, in cobalt blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: the Banpo Bridge in Seoul at night with the glowing city skyline and a long row of lit bridge lamps behind; she stands in the middle of the road on the asphalt, car headlights and taillights streaking as long glowing white and red light trails in smooth curves on both sides of her, a deep dark-blue night sky behind her, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by the bridge lights and the glow of the light trails with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot as a long-exposure photograph taken from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height on a tripod, glowing white and red car light trails streaking in long smooth lines across the road around her while she stands perfectly sharp and still in the middle, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the lane markings, a roadside barrier and street lamps around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8 with a 2-second exposure, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
